name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 39 - Am 44
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 39a. Calls on the Member States and local authorities to use all current tools to combat ‘Airbnbisation’ abuses, including the possibility of establishing zones reserved for primary residences and of establishing a maximum quota of tourist rental units in high-demand areas; calls on the Commission to facilitate such measures by providing guidance on their compatibility with EU law and supporting the exchange of good practices between Member States and municipalities; considers it important to introduce effective sanctions against platforms and owners circumventing local housing rules;
